headline: Anthropic faces internal exodus over surveillance system and AI safety concerns
body: Anthropic is confronting significant internal dissent following reports that the company is building a predictive surveillance system to monitor activists, prompting at least one researcher resignation and renewed safety warnings. Multiple Anthropic researchers have publicly questioned the company's direction, with concerns ranging from the surveillance initiative to fundamental AI safety risks. For healthcare AI stakeholders, this signals potential instability at a major LLM vendor and raises questions about governance standards that should inform clinical AI adoption decisions. Organizations evaluating Anthropic's models for EHR integration, clinical decision support, or sensitive healthcare applications should assess vendor stability and ethical guardrails as part of their procurement process. The convergence of internal safety warnings and external surveillance projects underscores why healthcare systems must scrutinize vendor values and safety culture alongside technical capabilities.
